description: README Layout table row to add after SupervisorProof: | Leanactors/Examples/SupervisorLive.lean | Liveness: under weak fairness of the signal step and of run 0, a dead child is eventually replaced (restart_eventually); two rank_leads_to stages on the position of the pending signal in the FIFO signal queue and of the EXIT in the supervisor's mailbox | . README status: file count +1, theorem count +~25 (SupervisorLive has 24 theorems + 8 defs). Suggested README paragraph under the Fair framework section: 'The supervisor is the first liveness result on Sys: restart_in_flight says the restart is in flight, SupervisorLive.restart_eventually says it arrives. The run must be weakly fair for signal and for run 0; nothing is assumed about down, timers or kills (NoKillTo 0 is an invariant from init). Stage A ranks the pending (0, c, _) signal by its position in the FIFO queue (a run only appends signals, a signal step pops the head), stage B ranks EXIT c _ by its position in the supervisor mailbox (every other step only appends to it, run 0 pops the head and either spawns or leaves the state alone). Both are SysRun.rank_leads_to through rank_leads_to_of_step, whose single hypothesis is one labelled-step lemma.' NOTES finding: the two-stage shape needed a wrapper because rank_leads_to's hnoinc/hdec quantify over P b even when Q b also holds (e.g. the EXIT is delivered and a second (0,c,_) signal is still queued): proving LeadsTo (P ∧ ¬Q) Q and discharging P → (P ∧ ¬Q) ∨ Q avoids proving the signals to c are unique.
